title.narrative: Percentage of BIOFIN event participants who rate the event as having been a significant learning experience.

description.narrative: The number of participants at BIOFIN events aimed at transferring biodiversity finance skills (e.g., conferences, webinars, workshops, MOOCs, and other events) who, in the post-event evaluation, rate the event as having been a significant learning experience, divided by the total number of participants who respond to the survey, multiplied by 100. In capacity development programmes conducted since July 2022, post programme evaluations, there is a specific question related to the significance of the programme for their learning. Measurement reflects the percentage of respondents who have identified the programme as a significant contributor to their knowledge on biodiversity financing.

title.narrative: Number of FS-specific pro-biodiversity finance policy documents and mechanisms adopted

description.narrative: The number of pro-biodiversity finance policy documents and mechanisms produced with BIOFIN support and delivered to the relevant officials for adoption that are officially adopted. 'Officially adopted' means that the necessary policy, legal, administrative/ institutional, enforcement, and/or other relevant arrangements are in place for the finance solution to be able to be considered to be in effect and/or operational. This refers to number of policy documents officially adopted by the government linking the PES and biodiversity finance- recognizing the important role PES could play in biodiversity management.
